_readme: Hand-derived numbers for the QF fixture store (TST-1). Each value comes from the timeline in make.py and the spec rule named in its note, never from the code under test. Times are UTC ISO strings, durations ms, money USD. Keys marked b3 need the B3 fold (display_ix, attr_*, time_split, stretches, projects, local rollup_time, max_silence_ms, skill_load); the rest are stored by the loader today. Do not change a value to make a test pass: report both numbers.
